  1. Show HN: A custom font based on the Jamaican flag alphabet

    • Design
    • Typography

    56 points · 9 comments · 15 Nov 2026, 00:56 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — Jamaican Alphabet Font is an experimental font inspired by treating Jamaica’s flag as the letter X. It includes regular and connected variants, with colors and shapes encoded in the font and contextual features joining selected glyphs.

    Discussion — The short thread was positive. A commenter linked a fuller making-of post and asked about color choices; the author explained that alternate color variants exist but default rules avoid an overly stripey result.
